messages:
emma (AE): Quick sync on Catalyst swap from VendorX -> Redwood. Their procurement wants a short presales playbook: POC scope, cost delta, security answers, and a rollback plan. Can we sketch this here?
anya (SE): I'll lead the compatibility tests. Plan: 3-day tech spike + 4-day extended run. Run 40 canonical prompts + 20 edge prompts (stop-seq / streaming / multi-turn). Capture n=1 vs n=3 behavior.
ryan (SRE): Infrastructure note: for the POC we can do hosted-eu pin in eu-west-1 or Dedicated in their VPC. If they want identical egress IPs for allowlisting we need to allocate static NATs. Which do they prefer?
meera (Pricing): I'll produce 3 pricing scenarios: 1) hosted pay-as-you-go, 2) 12-mo committed, 3) Dedicated monthly commit. Include per-token, per-embedding lines + estimated savings for batching/kv-cache.
claire (Security): They sent a 45-question vendor security sheet. I can fill 80% from our standard pack, but need KMS key rotation & data-retention owners. Also they require signed Data Processing Addendum (DPA) and EU residency diagram.
lee (Legal): I can review DPA + SLA addendum. For Dedicated SLA with latency targets we'll need to cap remedy to credits. Do they require termination rights on outage?
emma (AE): Good flag. Catalyst asked for a 99.9% uptime + p95 latency target similar to current VendorX contract. They want the SLA in the POC docs.
anya (SE): On response parity: VendorX returns an array of choices with per-token probabilities. Differences to watch: tokenization boundaries, stop sequence precedence, and trailing whitespace handling. For parity we should: - request n=3, - return choices[] with `logprobs`, - include token offsets in our shim.
anya (SE): Example adapter (not production):
```
# pseudo-adapter
resp = redwood.generate(model="r-bert-1", prompt=p, n=3)
adapted = []
for c in resp.choices:
    adapted.append({"text": c.text, "prob": c.logprob, "tokens": c.tokens})
# mimic vendorx top-pick logic
adapted.sort(key=lambda x: x['prob'], reverse=True)
return {"vendorx_compat": adapted}
```
ryan (SRE): For telemetry please preserve x-request-id and return x-compat-ratelimit headers. We'll also capture p95/p50 latency in the sandbox and provide an exportable CSV for their ops team.
claire (Security): One blocker: Catalyst wants KMS wrapped keys under their tenant KMS (bring-your-own-key). Hosted cannot do BYOK today; Dedicated can with HSM integration but lead time is 4 weeks. Need to surface this as a hard constraint.
meera (Pricing): If BYOK is required, pricing should include an integration professional services line and a 4-week ramp. I'll model cost impact.
emma (AE): They also use an internal reranking step: VendorX returns top 5, then they run a confidence model to pick 1. Can we expose the candidate list so they keep their reranker?
anya (SE): Yes, we'll expose all candidates and logprobs. Suggest we deliver a small helper library that maps VendorX fields -> Redwood fields so their existing reranker can be reused with minimal change.
lee (Legal): For the presales packet I want a simple rollback plan: keep VendorX endpoint active, DNS switch window, and a post-cutover verification checklist. Keep the legal risk statement short.
emma (AE): Timeline proposal: Thu submit prompt set + sample outputs, Fri we provision sandbox, Mon run traffic replay, Tue parity report + cost delta. Can everyone confirm?
ryan (SRE): Confirm but need IP allowlist completed 24h before replay. Also add a network flow diagram request from their infra team.
claire (Security): I'll attach SOC2 report and start the security questionnaire today. Need product owner for data retention answers.
meera (Pricing): Quote draft: https://redwood.app/sales/quotes/CAT-859 (includes 12/36 mo tiers). I'll lock numbers after we confirm token distribution.
build-bot: Sandbox cluster creation queued: 2024-10-02T03:00:00Z. Link: https://ci.redwood.internal/builds/9033
emma (AE): Action items: 1) Catalyst to send 60 prompts + 10 problematic outputs, 2) Anya to deliver adapter + parity tests, 3) Claire to finish questionnaire + residency diagram, 4) Meera to finalize quote, 5) Ryan to schedule replay and confirm IPs. If any can't make deadline call it out here. :shipit:
